notes.title: Full Release! Tutorial Book, New Settings & Key Mapping
notes.notes:
[h1]Ahoy Pirates![/h1]

We've released the final update for now for full release but we will still fix bugs. We're looking to setup a kick starter now for a new and improved version of StoneTide as we don't have the resources to add more content to this one.

[h2]Tutorial Book:[/h2]
[img]https://scontent.fper7-1.fna.fbcdn.net/v/t1.15752-9/127059997_948146105593776_6253834073800060327_n.png?_nc_cat=109&ccb=2&_nc_sid=ae9488&_nc_ohc=QCIi-4NEHYQAX9LAg0a&_nc_ht=scontent.fper7-1.fna&oh=668bb29f51ba3c833cf10652b4ec00ec&oe=5FE57A25[/img]
Learn everything about the game reading the tutorial book in-game, just right click it in your inventory.

[h2]New Settings HUD:[/h2]
[img]https://scontent.fper7-1.fna.fbcdn.net/v/t1.15752-9/128085064_127379218974383_838062705479885744_n.jpg?_nc_cat=104&ccb=2&_nc_sid=ae9488&_nc_ohc=uz9VGfTJORQAX9f41QG&_nc_ht=scontent.fper7-1.fna&oh=6df14dbd3998c810a0d2db3f15f8c6a8&oe=5FE5594F[/img]
A much more polished look along with an option to set full screen or windowed mode.

[h2]New Key Binding Controls:[/h2]
[img]https://scontent.fper7-1.fna.fbcdn.net/v/t1.15752-9/126872803_369621590968099_3483536303754276814_n.jpg?_nc_cat=102&ccb=2&_nc_sid=ae9488&_nc_ohc=naqJ3qYzGH0AX9A6gBb&_nc_ht=scontent.fper7-1.fna&oh=941dd2086c3ea3840080fb32c2636f2f&oe=5FE627B4[/img]
As requested we've added key bindings so player can play whether left or right handed.

Stay tuned for more announcements on the upcoming kick starter campaign.

Thanks for staying with us,

StoneTide Entertainment

notes.title: StoneTide - (Major) Patch 10 - December 24, 2019
notes.notes:
Hey StoneTiders,

We got a nice big patch as a Christmas present from us!

We fixed the following bugs and added new features..

Features Added:

[list]
[*] Start game in monitors resolution.
[*] Basic tutorial in the main menu.
[*] In-game crafting recipes book to look at anytime.
[*] Added a new font. (Still implementing this to sprites.)
[/list]

Bugs fixed:

[list]
[*] Can't collect Sea Stones at night.
[*] Resize chatbox with the HUD size buttons.
[*] Cooked meat icon overly small.
[*] Workbench crafting hud boxes appear too close when the hud is resized.
[*] Can place misc items in the enchantment shop.
[*] Unable to place resources to build canoe or a ship when in x2 or x4 HUD size.
[*] Couldn't take damage when on 0 hunger and higher thirst. (Opposite fixed as well.)
[*] Bug where you could add extra health to the merc by dragging health potions onto them.
[*] Day count didn't save.
[*] Enemy ships weren't spawning in the last patch.
[/list]

We plan on adding key mapping for a full list of controls and finishing the new font to all the sprites, coming soon.

Merry Christmas,

Ben

notes.title: StoneTide - (Major) Patch 4 - April 29th, 2019
notes.notes:
Hey StoneTiders!

We have fixed/added the following bugs and features in game..

[b]Bugs Fixed:[/b]
[*] Hunger and Thirst replenishes when you respawn.
[*] Action bar number hotkeys to 3-0.
[*] Settings in the main menu.
[*] You can create unlimited planks in the workbench at no cost.
[*] Moving a stack you want to combine into a chest, furnace and workbench replaces it instead.
[*] Stacks disappear when taking them out of the workbench and chest.
[*] Menu music playing multiple times in the main menu.
[/list]

[b]Features Added:[/b][list]
[*] Escape to quit all HUD's in game and to quit the game only when on the main menu.
[*] Re-spawn with a basic pick-axe and axe when you die.
[*] Enabled stamina regeneration when at 0 hunger and/or thirst.
[*] Replaced in-game settings HUD.
[*] Added a new font. (Not finished implementing to all HUD's yet.)
[*] Got rid of the flax item in sea crates.
[/list]
More coming soon!

Thanks,

Ben
